title: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Developer Kit / Super
notes: The carrier board is 100 x 79 mm and 1.57 mm thick, with six 2.75 mm unplated holes (official Jetson Orin Nano Developer Kit Carrier Board Specification SP-11324-001 v1.3, figure 4-1, and the outline and drill layers of the official P3768 A04 reference design files). The four used here are 86 x 58 mm apart, 4 mm from the l = 0 end, 17 mm from the s = 0 edge and 4 mm from the s = S edge; the developer kit's base is screwed to these four. The other two are 6 mm further towards l = L and are not used.
The Jetson Orin Nano Super Developer Kit is the same hardware: the official user guide says the existing developer kit gets the Super performance with a software upgrade.

s = 0 is the front edge with the power jack, DisplayPort, four USB-A, Ethernet and USB-C, which stick out 1.9 mm past it. s = S, where the microSD card goes into the slot under the module, faces the back plate. The 40-pin header runs along the l = L end and the two camera connectors are at the l = 0 end.

Under the board are the M.2 Key E slot with the Wi-Fi card and two M.2 Key M slots, 2230 and 2280. In the official 3D model (P3766-P3768SKU4-P3767ENVELOPE.stp) the deepest are the Wi-Fi card and the 2230 SSD, 4.8 mm below the board; the specification gives 4.30 mm for the carrier board's own parts. The 8 mm standoffs leave 3.2 mm below them. The 2280 slot is empty in the model; its box puts an SSD at the height of the 2230 SSD, reaching the slot's standoff.
Standoffs 5 mm across: the nearest parts under the board are 3.4 mm from a hole centre (the pins of the fan connector next to the hole at l = 90, s = 75).

Parts: boxes round the parts in the official 3D model, rounded to 0.01 mm: the PCB, the module with its heatsink and fan, the connectors at the front edge, and under the board the M.2 slots with the Wi-Fi card and the SSDs.

The official 3D model is the developer kit on its base. exclude leaves out the base (375-0137-000), its four screws (155-0900-000) and the two Wi-Fi antennas, which the model puts in the base past the s = S edge, on cables from the Wi-Fi card.
